sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 接着，侦探们终于查出了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.zh: 认识一下达里尔。

sentences.en: Hiya.

sentences.en: Inspired by his garden makeover, he turned his attention to something else he'd been neglecting for years.
sentences.zh: 受花园改造的启发，他把注意力转向了他多年来一直忽视的另一件事物。

sentences.en: Yeah, my savings account, totally caught in a web of weeds.
sentences.zh: 没错，我的储蓄账户，完全陷入了一团乱麻之中。

sentences.en: So he cut away his old bank and opened a Macquarie savings account.
sentences.zh: 于是他抛弃了旧银行，开立了一个麦觉理储蓄账户。

sentences.en: Yeah, took minutes.
sentences.zh: 对，几分钟就搞定了。

sentences.en: With great rates and none of the usual hoops and catches, his savings are now thriving like never before.
sentences.zh: 凭借超高的利率以及没有繁文缛节和隐形条款的优势，他的储蓄现在正空前繁荣地增长。

sentences.en: Well, it's in a much better spot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在的状况好多了。

sentences.en: Don't lose interest in your savings.
sentences.zh: 不要对你的储蓄失去兴趣。

sentences.en: Demand more and say...
sentences.zh: 提出更多要求，并说……

sentences.en: I bank with Macquarie.
sentences.zh: 我在麦觉理银行开户。

sentences.zh: 你储蓄游戏规则的改变者。

sentences.zh: 在限速 60 公里的路段开 65 公里，在平均通勤时间里只能为你节省大约 75 秒。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: Just 75 seconds.

sentences.en: But it doubles your risk of crashing.
sentences.zh: 但它却让你的撞车风险翻倍。

sentences.en: It may not feel like speeding, but it is.
sentences.zh: 你可能觉得这不算超速，但其实就是。

sentences.en: Casual speeding is the biggest cause of deaths and serious injuries on New South Wales roads.
sentences.zh: 偶发性超速是新南威尔士州道路上造成死亡和重伤的最大原因。

sentences.en: Is 75 seconds worth the risk?
sentences.zh: 这 75 秒真的值得冒这个险吗？

sentences.zh: 保持在限速以下。

sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且通常令人痛心的事件。

sentences.en: 41-year-old Sakaya Yokota felt slightly nervous as the clock ticked past 7pm on Tuesday, November 15, 1977.
sentences.zh: 1977 年 11 月 15 日星期二晚上 7 点刚过，41 岁的早川早纪子感到有些紧张。

sentences.en: Her daughter, Megumi, age 13, was late in returning home from the badminton practice she attended after school.
sentences.zh: 她 13 岁的女儿横田惠放学后参加羽毛球训练，回家却迟到了。

sentences.en: Megumi walked to and from her middle school each day and, no matter how late her badminton practice ran, she was usually home by 6 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 横田惠每天步行上下中学，不管羽毛球训练结束得有多晚，她通常在 6 点前就能到家。

sentences.en: If there was a deviation from that plan, she made sure to let Sakaya know.
sentences.zh: 如果计划有变，她一定会让早纪子知道。

sentences.en: The previous day, the badminton club had held a post-training meeting, which Megumi had made sure to tell her mother about in advance.
sentences.zh: 前一天，羽毛球俱乐部开过训练后会议，横田惠事先特意告诉了母亲。

sentences.en: She'd arrived home at 6.30 that night, half an hour later than usual.
sentences.zh: 那天她晚上 6 点半到家，比平时晚了半小时。

sentences.en: But Megumi hadn't said anything about another meeting or anything else that might delay her return home on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 但横田惠并没有提及周二还有别的会议或其他会耽误她回家的事情。

sentences.en: After checking whether Megumi's twin brothers, who were 9 years old, knew where their big sister might be,
sentences.zh: 在确认了 9 岁的双胞胎弟弟是否知道姐姐可能在哪里之后，

sentences.en: Sakaya decided to go out and look for her daughter.
sentences.zh: 早纪子决定出门寻找女儿。

sentences.en: She put on some sandals and left the large, single-storey home where the Yokota family lived, on the coast of the Japanese port city of Nikita.
sentences.zh: 她穿上凉鞋，离开了横田一家居住在位于日本港口城市新潟海岸的一层大宅。

sentences.en: The Yokotas, Sakaya, her husband Shigeru, and their three children Megumi, Tatsuya, and Takuya, had only lived there for just over a year.
sentences.zh: 横田一家——早纪子、丈夫滋以及他们的三个孩子横田惠、达也和拓也——搬到这里才刚满一年多。

sentences.en: They were used to moving about, as Shigeru's work for the Bank of Japan saw him transferred to a different city every few years.
sentences.zh: 他们习惯了搬迁，因为滋在 日本银行工作，每隔几年就会被调到不同的城市。

sentences.en: They had relocated from Hiroshima to Nikita almost 18 months earlier, in July of 1976.
sentences.zh: 大约 18 个月前的 1976 年 7 月，他们从广岛搬到了新潟。

sentences.en: The neighbourhood where they lived was filled with grand homes and was just a few minutes' walk from the beach.
sentences.zh: 他们居住的街区到处都是宏伟的住宅，距离海滩仅几分钟步行路程。

sentences.en: It was late autumn and the sun had already set hours earlier.
sentences.zh: 当时已是深秋，太阳几个小时前就已落山。

sentences.en: Sakaya Yokota hurried along the dark, dimly lit streets towards Megumi's school, expecting to bump into her daughter along the route.
sentences.zh: 横田早纪子顺着黑暗、昏暗的街道快步走向横田惠的学校，希望能一路上偶遇女儿。

sentences.en: But she arrived at the school without seeing Megumi.
sentences.zh: 但她到达学校时并没有看到横田惠。

sentences.en: When Sakaya headed towards the gymnasium, she felt a flood of relief as she saw its lights were on and heard female voices chatting inside.
sentences.zh: 当早纪子走向体育馆时，看到里面亮着灯，并听到里面有女性说话的笑声，她感到一阵如释重负。

sentences.en: Believing Megumi must still be practising, she almost turned to walk back home.
sentences.zh: 她以为横田惠肯定还在练习，差点就转身走回家了。

sentences.en: But something stopped her.
sentences.zh: 但有什么东西阻止了她。

sentences.en: Wanting to make sure, Sakaya went to the gymnasium's entrance and saw a group of women inside playing volleyball.
sentences.zh: 为了确认一下，早纪子走到体育馆入口，看到里面有一群女性在打排球。

sentences.en: The voices she'd heard had belonged to them and not to the students.
sentences.zh: 她听到的声音是她们的，而不是学生们的。

sentences.en: Gripped by fear again, Sakaya ran to the school's main entrance and saw a security guard standing there.
sentences.zh: 恐惧再次涌上心头，早纪子跑到学校正门，看到那里站着一名保安。

sentences.en: Have the students who were practising badminton in the gymnasium gone home, she asked.
sentences.zh: 她问，在体育馆练习羽毛球的学生回家了吗？

sentences.en: His answer filled her with dread.
sentences.zh: 他的回答让她充满恐惧。

sentences.en: They left a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 他们早就走了。

sentences.en: All the students left a little after six.
sentences.zh: 所有学生在六点刚过就都走了。

sentences.en: Sakaya ran all the way home, trying to calm herself with possible scenarios along the way.
sentences.zh: 早纪子一路小跑回了家，一路上试图用各种可能的假设来安慰自己。

sentences.en: Megumi might have walked a different route home than usual or gone to visit a friend.
sentences.zh: 横田惠可能是走了平时不一样的路线回家，或者去拜访朋友了。

sentences.en: Once Sakaya was back at home, she set about phoning some of Megumi's friends who had been at badminton practice with her.
sentences.zh: 早纪子一回到家，便开始打电话给几个和横田惠一起参加羽毛球训练的朋友。

sentences.en: None of them were with Megumi and all were shocked that she wasn't home yet.
sentences.zh: 她们谁也没有和横田惠在一起，并且都对她还没回家感到震惊。

sentences.en: They'd all left practice more than an hour earlier.
sentences.zh: 她们一个多小时前就都结束训练离开了。

sentences.en: They'd chatted for a little bit outside the school firSt.
sentences.zh: 她们先是在学校外面聊了一会儿。

sentences.en: Megumi had been laughing and everything had seemed normal.
sentences.zh: 横田惠当时一直在笑，一切看起来都很正常。

sentences.en: Then she left at about 6.25pm with two friends.
sentences.zh: 然后她在晚上 6 点 25 分左右和两个朋友一起离开。

sentences.en: The three girls walked part of the way together along a long street that led to the sea.
sentences.zh: 三个女孩沿着通往大海的长街一起走了一段路。

sentences.en: One of Megumi's friends soon turned right at a corner.
sentences.zh: 横田惠的一个朋友不久在一个拐角处右转了。

sentences.en: Her other friend subsequently turned left at a busy intersection.
sentences.zh: 她的另一个朋友随后在一个繁忙的十字路口左转了。

sentences.en: She and Megumi said goodbye at 6.35pm.
sentences.zh: 她和横田惠在晚上 6 点 35 分告别。

sentences.en: Megumi would have continued straight for two more blocks before turning left to reach her house.
sentences.zh: 横田惠本应继续直行两个街区，然后左转才能到家。

sentences.en: The walk from the intersection to the Yokota residence wouldn't take more than a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 从十字路口走到横田家只需几分钟时间。

sentences.en: Sakaya also called Megumi's badminton coach, who urged Sakaya to stay calm.
sentences.zh: 早纪子还打电话给横田惠的羽毛球教练，教练劝早纪子保持冷静。

sentences.en: Megumi might have stopped off somewhere else, like a bookshop.
sentences.zh: 横田惠可能在其他地方逗留了，比如书店。

sentences.en: But Sakaya knew it wasn't in her daughter's character to go somewhere without letting her know.
sentences.zh: 但早纪子知道，不打招呼就去别的地方不是女儿的性格。

sentences.en: She grabbed a torch and took her two sons out to look for Megumi with her.
sentences.zh: 她抓起手电筒，带着两个儿子一起出去寻找横田惠。

sentences.en: Sakaya searched the neighbouring streets, a Gokoku shrine that sat a few blocks away, and the long road that led to the sea, which Megumi had walked with her friends.
sentences.zh: 早纪子搜寻了附近的街道、几个街区外的一座护国神社，以及横田惠和朋友们走过的那条通往大海的长路。

sentences.en: Sakaya shone the torch into parked cars that lined the street and looked out across the beach's shore.
sentences.zh: 早纪子用手电筒照着路边停放的汽车，并眺望海滩的岸边。

sentences.en: There was no sign of Megumi.
sentences.zh: 没有横田惠的踪影。

sentences.en: Sakaya began to panic that her daughter might be locked in the boot of one of the nearby parked cars, but had no way of opening them to check.
sentences.zh: 早纪子开始恐慌，担心女儿可能被锁在附近某辆停放的汽车后备箱里，但又没有办法打开它们进行检查。

sentences.en: At a loss, she and the boys walked back home at around 8 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 无计可施之下，她和男孩们在 8 点左右走回了家。

sentences.en: Shortly after they arrived, the home phone rang.
sentences.zh: 他们到家后不久，家里的电话铃响了。

sentences.en: It was Shigeru Yokota, Sakaya's husband and the children's father.
sentences.zh: 打电话来的是早纪子的丈夫、孩子们的父亲横田滋。

sentences.en: He was calling to say he'd be home late due to a work event, but Sakaya begged him to come home right away, explaining the situation.
sentences.zh: 他打电话说因为有一个工作活动会晚点回家，但早纪子哀求他马上回家，并向他说明了情况。

sentences.en: Shigeru rushed home in a taxi and immediately went out to search for Megumi.
sentences.zh: 横田滋坐出租车赶回家，并立即出门寻找横田惠。

sentences.en: Finding no sign of her, he decided it was time to call the police.
sentences.zh: 在找不到她的踪迹后，他决定是时候报警了。

sentences.en: At 9.50pm, police from Nigata Police Central Station arrived at the Yokota residence and set about searching for the missing 13-year-old.
sentences.zh: 晚上 9 点 50 分，新潟警察署中央派出所的警察赶到横田家，开始搜寻失踪的 13 岁女孩。

sentences.en: They were joined by colleagues from a neighbouring district.
sentences.zh: 邻近地区的同事也加入了他们的行列。

sentences.en: The officers searched some of the same places Sakaya had, as well as a nearby pine forest and a nearby vacant lot dotted with overgrown shrubs
sentences.zh: 警官们搜查了早纪子去过的部分地点，以及附近的一片松林和长满灌木丛的空地，

sentences.en: where the University of Nikita Science Building had once stood.
sentences.zh: 新潟大学科学楼曾在那儿伫立。

sentences.en: Two sniffer dogs were given Megumi's scent via the pyjamas that she'd worn the previous night and taken to the intersection where she was last seen.
sentences.zh: 两条搜救犬通过横田惠前一天晚上穿的睡衣闻了闻她的气味，然后被带到她最后被看到的十字路口。

sentences.en: The dogs immediately continued straight along the street that Megumi would have walked.
sentences.zh: 警犬立刻顺着横田惠本应走过的那条街直行。

sentences.en: When they reached the corner where Megumi should have turned left, they abruptly stopped.
sentences.zh: 当它们到达横田惠本应左转的拐角处时，突然停了下来。

sentences.en: They turned around and around in circles, refusing to walk any further.
sentences.zh: 它们在原地转了一圈又一圈，拒绝再向前走一步。

sentences.en: Megumi's scent had been lost less than 250 metres from her home.
sentences.zh: 横田惠的气味在离家不到 250 米的地方消失了。

sentences.en: The search was called off at midnight and resumed at 5am.
sentences.zh: 搜寻工作在午夜取消，并于早上 5 点恢复。

sentences.en: Police formed a grid search to examine the beach and other locations in more detail.
sentences.zh: 警察组成了网格搜寻队，对海滩和其他地点进行更详细的检查。

sentences.en: Divers searched the sea, checking between the concrete tetrapods used to protect the shoreline in case Megumi's body was stuck under one.
sentences.zh: 潜水员搜查了大海，检查了用于保护海岸线的混凝土四角锥之间，以防横田惠的尸体卡在其中一个下面。

sentences.en: They door-knocked the area and stood at the intersection where Megumi was last seen, holding a photograph of her and questioning passers-by.
sentences.zh: 他们挨家挨户敲门走访该地区，并站在横田惠最后被看到的十字路口，拿着她的照片询问路人。

sentences.en: But nobody had seen Megumi and nothing belonging to her was found.
sentences.zh: 但没有人见过横田惠，也没有找到任何属于她的东西。

sentences.en: It was as though she'd just disappeared without a trace.
sentences.zh: 她就像是凭空消失了一样。

sentences.en: A special unit tasked with handling kidnapping cases was called in.
sentences.zh: 一个专门处理绑架案件的特别小组被调来协助。

sentences.en: They put a tracer on the Yokota's family's telephone and parked unmarked cars nearby to keep a close eye on things.
sentences.zh: 他们在横田一家的电话上安装了追踪器，并在附近停放了便衣车辆以密切监视情况。

sentences.en: Hoping desperately that someone might call with the news of Megumi,
sentences.zh: 怀着有人会打电话提供横田惠消息的绝望希望，

sentences.en: Sakaiya and Shigeru slept fully clothed night after night by the phone.
sentences.zh: 早纪子和横田滋夜复一夜地穿着衣服睡在电话机旁。

sentences.en: No one claiming responsibility for Megumi's disappearance ever rang.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人打电话声称对横田惠的失踪负责。

sentences.en: After a week went by with no calls and no information from the members of the public being stopped and questioned a daily, police decided to go public with their investigation.
sentences.zh: 在没有电话、每天被拦下盘问的公众也没有提供任何信息的情况下过了一周后，警方决定将调查公之于众。

sentences.en: On Tuesday November 22, the local newspaper ran a big article on Megumi's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 11 月 22 日星期二，当地报纸刊登了一篇关于横田惠失踪的大幅报道。

sentences.en: The story also reached the national papers.
sentences.zh: 这则新闻也登上了全国性报纸。

sentences.en: The Yokota family were hopeful that this media coverage would result in some much-needed leads.
sentences.zh: 横田一家希望这些媒体报道能带来一些急需的线索。

sentences.en: They also made appearances on several daytime television shows to publicise their daughter's case.
sentences.zh: 他们还出现在几个日间电视节目中，以宣传他们女儿的案件。

sentences.en: But nothing ever followed.
sentences.zh: 但后来什么也没有发生。

sentences.en: As days turned to weeks with no answers, the Yokotas struggled to make sense of their new reality.
sentences.zh: 随着日子一天天过去，几周过去却没有答案，横田一家努力去理解他们的新现实。

sentences.en: Megumi's nine-year-old twin brothers cried frequently, asking their parents, where did Megumi go?
sentences.zh: 横田惠 9 岁的双胞胎弟弟经常哭泣，问他们的父母，横田惠去哪儿了？

sentences.en: Sakaiya Yokota felt overwhelmed by anxiety and became highly emotional.
sentences.zh: 横田早纪子感到被焦虑压垮，情绪变得非常激动。

sentences.en: Shigeru managed to remain composed, holding himself together for his family.
sentences.zh: 横田滋设法保持镇定，为了家庭勉强撑着。

sentences.en: He constantly reassured them, she is alright, she will be back.
sentences.zh: 他不断安慰他们，她很好，她会回来的。

sentences.en: Sakaiya Yokota clutched at hope that her daughter might have gone missing of her own volition.
sentences.zh: 横田早纪子紧紧抓住一丝希望，希望女儿可能是自己离家出走的。

sentences.en: The move from Hiroshima to Nigata the previous year hadn't been easy.
sentences.zh: 前一年从广岛搬到新潟并不容易。

sentences.en: Although the family was provided for by Shigeru's employer, who gave them a big house in a lovely neighbourhood to live in,
sentences.zh: 虽然横田一家的生活由横田滋的雇主提供保障，雇主在风景优美的街区给他们提供了一栋大房子住，

sentences.en: Megumi missed Hiroshima and was initially lonely.
sentences.zh: 但横田惠很想念广岛，起初感到很孤独。

sentences.en: Sakaiya empathised with her daughter.
sentences.zh: 早纪子对女儿感同身受。

sentences.en: From the moment she first set eyes on Nigata, she felt it was a forlorn and lonely place.
sentences.zh: 从她第一眼看到新潟起，她就觉得这是一个荒凉孤独的地方。

sentences.en: Like Megumi, Sakaiya missed the sunny streets of Hiroshima.
sentences.zh: 和横田惠一样，早纪子也很想念广岛阳光明媚的街道。

sentences.en: Megumi had soon settled into school and made friends, but perhaps she'd been unhappier than she let on.
sentences.zh: 横田惠很快适应了学校生活并交了朋友，但也许她比表现出来的要痛苦得多。

sentences.en: Maybe she'd become depressed about something and wanted to be alone.
sentences.zh: 也许她对某事感到沮丧并想要独自一人。

sentences.en: In the days before she went missing,
sentences.zh: 在她失踪前的几天里，

sentences.en: Megumi had been stressed about her badminton skills.
sentences.zh: 横田惠一直对自己的羽毛球技术感到压力山大。

sentences.en: The school badminton team she was a part of took the sport very seriously.
sentences.zh: 她所在的学校羽毛球对这项运动非常认真。

sentences.en: On Sunday November 13, there'd been a tournament for students of Megumi's age throughout the city.
sentences.zh: 11 月 13 日星期日，全市举行了针对横田惠这个年龄段学生的锦标赛。

sentences.en: She and her partner had competed in doubles and placed fifth.
sentences.zh: 她和搭档参加了双打比赛并获得第五名。

sentences.en: Sakaiya and Shigeru had been proud of their daughter, but Megumi was hard on herself, saying,
sentences.zh: 早纪子和横田滋为女儿感到骄傲，但横田惠对自己很苛刻，说道，

sentences.en: She'd agonised about what she perceived as her poor performance and her anxiety only increased after she found out she'd been chosen to attend a special training camp.
sentences.zh: 她为自己认为糟糕的表现感到痛苦，在得知自己被选中参加一个特别训练营后，她的焦虑更是与日俱增。

sentences.en: Not thinking she was good enough for the camp,
sentences.zh: 由于觉得自己还不够资格去训练营，

sentences.en: Megumi thought about telling her badminton coach that she wouldn't participate.
sentences.zh: 横田惠曾考虑告诉羽毛球教练她不参加了。

sentences.en: On the day she went missing, she'd been planning to speak to him about it.
sentences.zh: 在她失踪那天，她正计划找他谈谈这件事。

sentences.en: Sakaiya feared that her daughter's anxiety might have been so great that she'd taken her own life by jumping into the sea.
sentences.zh: 早纪子担心女儿的焦虑可能太严重了，以至于她跳海自尽了。

sentences.en: Or maybe she'd run away.
sentences.zh: 或者她可能离家出走了。

sentences.en: They called friends and relatives who lived in other cities, but no one had seen her.
sentences.zh: 他们打电话给住在其他城市的朋友和亲戚，但没有人见过她。

sentences.en: Nor did police find any trace of Megumi on ferry passenger lists.
sentences.zh: 警察也没有在渡轮乘客名单上找到横田惠的任何踪迹。

sentences.en: Megumi's father, Shigeru, was less inclined to believe his daughter had run away.
sentences.zh: 横田惠的父亲横田滋不太愿意相信女儿是离家出走的。

sentences.en: After all, she'd left all of her clothes and her winter jacket behind, along with her allowance and bank account deposit book.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，她把所有的衣服、冬大衣以及零花钱和银行存折都留下了。

sentences.en: Nor did he believe that his daughter had taken her life.
sentences.zh: 他也不相信女儿自寻短见。

sentences.en: Megumi was a cheerful, bright and active girl who loved her family, especially her younger brothers.
sentences.zh: 横田惠是一个开朗、聪慧、活跃的女孩，她热爱她的家人，尤其是她的弟弟们。

sentences.en: She had many interests, including music, painting and books.
sentences.zh: 她有很多爱好，包括音乐、绘画和书籍。

sentences.en: Despite disagreeing over what might have happened to their daughter,
sentences.zh: 尽管对女儿可能发生了什么意见不一，

sentences.en: Sakaiya and Shigeru walked together to the beach every day just in case some of Megumi's belongings washed up on the shore.
sentences.zh: 堺谷和茂天天一起走到海滩，以防めぐみ（惠）的某些随身物品被冲上岸。

sentences.en: About two months after Megumi went missing, the phone rang at their house one day in January 1978.
sentences.zh: めぐみ失踪大约两个月后，1978年1月的一天，他们家里的电话响了。

sentences.en: Sakaiya picked it up, answering yes, when the caller on the other line asked if they had the Yokota residence.
sentences.zh: 当电话那头的人询问这里是不是横田家时，堺谷接起电话回答说是。

sentences.en: I have Megumi with me, the caller said.
sentences.zh: 来电者说，めぐみ在我手上。

sentences.en: Upon hearing this,
sentences.zh: 听到这话，

sentences.en: Sakaiya's legs began to shake.
sentences.zh: 堺谷的双腿开始发抖。

sentences.en: She was both shocked by his words and felt a sense of hope.
sentences.zh: 她既为他的话感到震惊，又怀有一丝希望。

sentences.en: By this stage, the tracer had been removed from the telephone, as police had long discounted the notion that Megumi might have been kidnapped for ransom.
sentences.zh: 在这个阶段，电话上的追踪器已经被拆除了，因为警方早就排除了めぐみ可能是被绑架勒索的想法。

sentences.en: Sakaiya asked the caller to please hold for one moment, then scribbled a note that read,
sentences.zh: 堺谷请来电者稍等片刻，然后匆忙写下一张便条，上面写着：

sentences.en: Phone call from kidnapper.
sentences.zh: 绑匪来电。

sentences.en: Call police.
sentences.zh: 报警。

sentences.en: Go next door.
sentences.zh: 去隔壁。

sentences.en: She handed the note to one of her sons, who was home sick from school.
sentences.zh: 她把便条递给因病没去上学而在家的一个儿子。

sentences.en: Sakaiya then returned to the call and tried to placate the man on the other end while she waited.
sentences.zh: 随后堺谷回到电话旁，一边等待，一边试图安抚电话那头的男子。

sentences.en: He sounded like he was in his mid-twenties.
sentences.zh: 听声音他像是二十多岁。

sentences.en: Soon, Sakaiya's son returned with the neighbour.
sentences.zh: 不久，堺谷的儿子带着邻居回来了。

sentences.en: They quietly sat and listened in on the call.
sentences.zh: 他们安静地坐着并旁听了这通电话。

sentences.en: The police quickly followed and attached a tracer to the phone while Sakaiya maintained the conversation.
sentences.zh: 警察很快赶到，在堺谷维持对话的同时，在电话上安装了追踪器。

sentences.en: It would take time for the tracer to work and Sakaiya needed to stretch out the call for as long as possible.
sentences.zh: 追踪器起作用需要时间，堺谷需要尽可能延长通话时间。

sentences.en: The caller made no demands, so Sakaiya started asking him questions.
sentences.zh: 来电者没有提出任何要求，于是堺谷开始向他提问。

sentences.en: She asked how he knew Megumi and where she was now.
sentences.zh: 她问他是怎么认识めぐみ的以及她现在在哪里。

sentences.en: The caller claimed to have met her at Nigata train station and he'd forced her to start working at a noodle shop.
sentences.zh: 来电者声称是在新潟火车站遇到她的，并且强迫她在一家面馆工作。

sentences.en: He provided the name of the shop.
sentences.zh: 他说出了那家店的名字。

sentences.en: You sound like a very young man, Sakaiya said.
sentences.zh: 堺谷说，听起来你还是个年轻人。

sentences.en: Why are you doing something that will make the police come after you when you have so much ahead of you?
sentences.zh: 你明明有那么长的前途，为什么要去做这种会让警察追捕你的事情呢？

sentences.en: Eventually, the caller made a ransom demand.
sentences.zh: 最终，来电者提出了勒索要求。

sentences.en: He wanted up to 8 million yen delivered near Hiyoriama Beach at 9pm that night.
sentences.zh: 他想要高达8万日元的赎金，并于当晚9点送到日和山海滩附近。

sentences.en: This was about 360km northeast of Nigata on the other side of the country.
sentences.zh: 这大约是新潟东北方360公里处，在国家的另一边。

sentences.en: Sakaiya promised to deliver the ransom herself.
sentences.zh: 堺谷答应自己去送赎金。

sentences.en: In the meantime, detectives had successfully traced the call to an apartment.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，侦探们已经成功将电话追踪到一个公寓。

sentences.en: Police arrived at the residence just as the caller was about to hang up the phone.
sentences.zh: 就在来电者即将挂断电话时，警察赶到了住所。

sentences.en: He wasn't in his 20s, as Sakaiya had thought.
sentences.zh: 他并不是堺谷所想的20多岁。

sentences.en: He was a high school student.
sentences.zh: 他是一名高中生。

sentences.en: Newspaper articles about Megumi's disappearance were strewn about the phone.
sentences.zh: 关于めぐみ失踪的报纸文章散落一地。

sentences.en: The teenager was taken into custody and interviewed at length over the next week or so.
sentences.zh: 这名青少年被拘留，并在接下来的一周左右时间里接受了详细盘问。

sentences.en: He quickly admitted that the call had been a hoax.
sentences.zh: 他很快承认这通电话是个恶作剧。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, police looked into his claims just to make sure.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，警方还是查证了他的说法以确保万无一失。

sentences.en: They tracked down the noodle shop he'd mentioned, but Megumi wasn't working there.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了他提到的面馆，但めぐみ并没有在那里工作。

sentences.en: Sakaiya and Shigeru felt their hope dissipate as suddenly as it had arrived.
sentences.zh: 堺谷和茂感到他们的希望像出现时一样突然地破灭了。

sentences.en: Over the next year, the police dedicated 3,000 man days to investigating Megumi's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的一年里，警方投入了3000个工日来调查めぐみ的失踪案。

sentences.en: Her young age meant the case was a top priority.
sentences.zh: 她年龄尚小，这意味着该案被列为重中之重。

sentences.en: But no trace of Megumi or any useful information was uncovered.
sentences.zh: 但没有发现めぐみ的任何踪迹，也没有找到任何有用的信息。

sentences.en: Only a few small clues came up during the course of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 在调查过程中只出现了一些小线索。

sentences.en: One was a report about something that had happened to another girl on the same day that Megumi went missing.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是一份关于另一个女孩在めぐみ失踪同一天遭遇的报告。

sentences.en: The girl was several years older than Megumi and lived nearby.
sentences.zh: 那个女孩比めぐみ大好几岁，住在附近。

sentences.en: She had been walking home at about 6pm that day, about 30 minutes before Megumi left her school.
sentences.zh: 那天下午6点左右她正走在回家路上，大约在她离开学校30分钟后。

sentences.en: She was walking down the same long street that took Megumi home when she noticed two men walking towards her from the beach.
sentences.zh: 她正走在那条送めぐみ回家的长街上，突然注意到有两个男人从海滩方向朝她走来。

sentences.en: As the girl passed the men, she felt uneasy.
sentences.zh: 当女孩从两人身边走过时，她感到一阵不安。

sentences.en: They both had stern expressions on their faces that made her uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 他们脸上严厉的表情让她很不舒服。

sentences.en: The girl glanced over her shoulder a moment later and, to her horror, she saw the two men had turned around and were now following her.
sentences.zh: 片刻后女孩回头看了一眼，令她惊恐的是，她发现那两个男人已经转过身，现在正尾随着她。

sentences.en: They were extremely close and the girl braced the tennis racket she was carrying in one hand, preparing to hit them.
sentences.zh: 他们靠得极近，女孩单手握紧了随身携带的网球拍，准备击打他们。

sentences.en: But the men abruptly stopped.
sentences.zh: 但两人突然停下了。

sentences.en: She hurried on, glancing back again once she was a little further away.
sentences.zh: 她加快脚步往前走，走到稍远一点的地方后又回头看了一眼。

sentences.en: The two men were looking at her and talking.
sentences.zh: 那两个男人正看着她并交谈着。

sentences.en: She ran the rest of the way home.
sentences.zh: 她一路小跑回了家。

sentences.en: When she later learned about Megumi's disappearance, she immediately told the police what had happened to her.
sentences.zh: 当她后来得知めぐみ失踪的消息时，她立即将自己的遭遇告诉了警方。

sentences.en: She also reported that she'd seen a parked car in the empty lot where the University of Nikita's old science building was.
sentences.zh: 她还报告说，她在新潟大学旧理科楼所在的空地上看到了一辆停着的车。

sentences.en: That same day, another woman also took note of a suspicious vehicle.
sentences.zh: 同一天，另一名女性也注意到了一辆可疑车辆。

sentences.en: This woman was the mother of a friend of Megumi's and she worked nearby.
sentences.zh: 这名女子是めぐみ一个朋友的母亲，在附近工作。

sentences.en: She'd been walking home from work when a light-coloured car paused in front of her.
sentences.zh: 她下班走路回家时，一辆浅色汽车在她面前停了下来。

sentences.en: One of the windows wound down and a person inside stretched their arm out, beckoning towards her.
sentences.zh: 其中一扇车窗摇了下去，里面的一只手臂伸出来向她招手。

sentences.en: Scared, the woman hurried away.
sentences.zh: 受到惊吓的女子快步走开。

sentences.en: Finally, one of the other students in the badminton club who'd been training with Megumi spotted a white car parked across the road on the school's north side.
sentences.zh: 最后，羽毛球俱乐部里另一位曾与めぐみ一起训练的学生发现学校北侧的马路对面上停着一辆白色的汽车。

sentences.en: The car stood out.
sentences.zh: 这辆车很显眼。

sentences.en: Private vehicles weren't allowed to park along that street due to a large hospital nearby.
sentences.zh: 由于附近有一家大医院，私家车是不允许停在那条街上的。

sentences.en: But, none of these sightings led to a particular car being identified, nor any man.
sentences.zh: 但是，这些目击事件都没有锁定某辆特定的汽车，也没有锁定任何人。

sentences.en: Months continued to pass, and then years.
sentences.zh: 几个月接着几个月过去，然后是几年。

sentences.en: It was impossible to understand how a 13-year-old girl could go missing from a well-populated city without someone seeing something.
sentences.zh: 简直无法理解一个13岁的女孩怎么会在一个人口稠密的城市里失踪而没有人看到点什么。

sentences.en: Every night, the Yokotas left their front door unlocked and the porch light on just in case Megumi came home.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上，横田夫妇都不锁大门并亮着门廊灯，以防めぐみ回家。

sentences.en: They even purchased a stronger light bulb so it would shine brighter.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至买了一个更亮的光源，这样能照得更亮。

sentences.en: Whenever she heard a car drive by at night,
sentences.zh: 每当她在夜里听到汽车驶过的声音，

sentences.en: Sakier rushed outside to check if it was her daughter coming home.
sentences.zh: 堺谷就会冲到外面去看看是不是女儿回家了。

sentences.en: The Yokotas also went to the police station to look at photographs of unidentified bodies that were made publicly available for one week each year in the hopes
sentences.zh: 横田夫妇还会去警察局查看每年公开展示一周的无名尸体照片，希望

sentences.en: that these unknown victims might be named.
sentences.zh: 这些未知的受害者能够被认出名字。

sentences.en: None of the photographs ever depicted Megumi.
sentences.zh: 这些照片中从来没有一张是めぐみ。

sentences.en: Every day, they scoured the newspapers in the hopes of a report that might be relevant.
sentences.zh: 他们每天都仔细搜寻报纸，希望能看到可能相关的报道。

sentences.en: On Monday,
sentences.zh: 在星期一，

sentences.en: January 7, 1980, more than two years after Megumi had gone missing, a friend of the Yokotas stopped by their home with an article they hadn't seen.
sentences.zh: 1980年1月7日，在めぐみ失踪两年多后，横田夫妇的一个朋友带着一篇他们没见过的文章来到他们家。

sentences.en: Published in a daily national paper, it bore the headline.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章发表在一家全国性日报上，醒目标题为：

sentences.en: Mysterious disappearance of three couples from beaches in Fukui,
sentences.zh: 1978年夏天福井、

sentences.en: Nigata, and Kagoshima in the summer of 1978.
sentences.zh: 新潟和鹿儿岛海滩三对夫妇神秘失踪。

sentences.en: It turned out that Megumi wasn't the only person who'd gone missing from a coastal area in recent years.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，めぐみ并不是近年来唯一从沿海地区失踪的人。

sentences.en: On Friday, July 7, 1978, a young couple,
sentences.zh: 1978年7月7日星期五，一对年轻情侣，

sentences.en: 23-year-olds
sentences.zh: 23岁的

sentences.en: Yasushi Chimura and Fukue Hamamoto, left their respective homes to go on a date.
sentences.zh: 地村保志和滨本富贵惠离开各自的家去约会。

sentences.en: Yasushi and Fukue headed to Wakasa Bay in Obama, a city in Japan's
sentences.zh: 保志和富贵惠前往日本

sentences.en: Fukui prefecture, more than 430 kilometres from Nigata.
sentences.zh: 福井县小滨市的若狭湾，距离新潟有430多公里。

sentences.en: The couple was never seen again.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣再也没有被看到过。

sentences.en: There was no reason for them to leave without telling anybody.
sentences.zh: 他们没有任何理由在不告诉任何人的情况下离开。

sentences.en: They were engaged to be married in four months' time and had already booked the reception hall for their wedding.
sentences.zh: 他们四个月后就要订婚结婚了，并且已经订好了婚礼的接待大厅。

sentences.en: Both families were delighted about the upcoming nuptials and the couple were happy in their lives.
sentences.zh: 双方家庭都为即将到来的婚礼感到高兴，这对情侣的生活也很幸福。

sentences.en: A few weeks later, on Monday, July 31, a 20-year-old university student named Kearu Hasewika left home on his bicycle, dressed in a t-shirt and shorts.
sentences.zh: 几周后的7月31日星期一，一个名叫长谷川桦的20岁大学生穿着T恤和短裤骑着自行车离家出走。

sentences.en: Kearu was in his third year of university and had returned home for the summer holidays to his family's residence in Kashiwazaki, a seaside city in Nigata prefecture,
sentences.zh: 长谷川桦正读大学三年级，暑假回家探亲，来到位于新潟县海滨城市柏崎的家人住所，

sentences.en: about 46 kilometres from Nigata.
sentences.zh: 距离新潟大约46公里。

sentences.en: Kearu had told his grandmother that he'd be home for dinner.
sentences.zh: 长谷川桦曾告诉祖母他会回家吃晚饭。

sentences.en: He was just heading out to meet a girl at the library.
sentences.zh: 他只是出门去图书馆见一个女孩。

sentences.en: 22-year-old beautician
sentences.zh: 22岁的美容师

sentences.en: Yukiko Okuda had told her mother she was meeting
sentences.zh: 奥田由纪子告诉母亲她要在下午6点

sentences.en: Kearu at the library at 6pm.
sentences.zh: 在图书馆见长谷川桦。

sentences.en: They planned to have tea together and then Yukiko would be home by 8 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 他们计划一起喝茶，然后由纪子会在8点前回家。

sentences.en: Neither of them ever came home.
sentences.zh: 他们谁也没有回家。

sentences.en: Kearu's bicycle was later found outside the library at a bike rack.
sentences.zh: 长谷川桦的自行车后来在图书馆外面的自行车架上被发现。

sentences.en: Two weeks after this, on Saturday August 12,
sentences.zh: 这之后的两周，即8月12日星期六，

sentences.en: 23-year-old
sentences.zh: 23岁的

sentences.en: Shuichi Ichikawa and 24-year-old
sentences.zh: 市川修一和24岁的

sentences.en: Rameko Masamoto went to a beach in Fugiaga,
sentences.zh: 增本留美子前往吹上浜的海滩，

sentences.en: Kagoshima prefecture,
sentences.zh: 位于鹿儿岛县，

sentences.en: about 1400 kilometres from Nigata, near the southern tip of Japan.
sentences.zh: 距离新潟大约1400公里，靠近日本南部边缘。

sentences.en: Their plan was to watch the sunset together.
sentences.zh: 他们的计划是一起看日落。

sentences.en: Both disappeared without a trace.
sentences.zh: 两人都消失得无影无踪。
